definitions.gloss: atmospheric pressure; air pressure; barometric pressure
definitions.explanation: The pressure exerted by the weight of the atmosphere. Used in weather forecasts and scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{低|てい}→低：03961_tei⟧{気圧|きあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧。
⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気圧|きあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: Atmospheric pressure is low at the mountaintop.

examples.japanese: {気圧|きあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I get headaches from changes in air pressure.
examples.notes: [Note: Weather-related headaches are common in Japan]

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧{気圧|きあつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧950ヘクトパスカルだ。
examples.english: The typhoon's central pressure is 950 hectopascals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気圧|きあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぱんぱん→ぱんぱん：29037_panpan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らむ→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The air pressure inside a plane is low, so bags of snacks sometimes puff up.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {高|こう}{気圧|きあつ} (high pressure system — brings clear weather)
- {低|てい}{気圧|きあつ} (low pressure system — brings clouds/rain)
- {気圧|きあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{谷|たに}→谷：02223_tani⟧ (pressure trough)
- {気圧|きあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧ (pressure change; {気圧|きあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, to get headaches from pressure changes)

USAGE:
Weather maps give pressure in hPa (ヘクトパスカル). {気圧|きあつ} is also a unit, the standard atmosphere:
- 1{気圧|きあつ} = 1013.25 hPa (standard atmospheric pressure)
